section.title: String Display
section.para: These events make it possible to dynamically modify output strings to interpret or add semantic meaning or markup. Examples include the creation of links to other bugs or bugnotes, as well as handling urls to other sites in general.

blockquote.para: This is an event to format bug ID numbers before being displayed, using the bug_format_id() API call. The result should be plain-text, as the resulting string is used in various formats and locations.

listitem.para: <String>: bug ID string to be displayed

blockquote.para: This is an event to format text before being sent in an email. Callbacks should be used to process text and convert it into a plaintext-readable format so that users with textual email clients can best utilize the information. Hyperlinks and other markup should be removed, leaving the core content by itself.
This is an event to format the subject line of an email before it is sent.

This is an event to display generic formatted text. The string to be displayed is passed between hooked callbacks, each taking a turn to modify the output in some specific manner. Text passed to this may be processed for all types of formatting and markup, including clickable links, presentation adjustments, etc.
This is an event to format content before being displayed in an RSS feed. Text should be processed to perform any necessary character escaping to preserve hyperlinks and other appropriate markup.

This is an event to display generic unformatted text. The string to be displayed is passed between hooked callbacks, each taking a turn to modify the output in some specific manner. Text passed to this event should only be processed for the most basic formatting, such as preserving line breaks and special characters.

section.title: Menu Items
section.para: These events allow new menu items to be inserted in order for new content to be added, such as new pages or integration with other applications.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the user account menu available to users from the 'My Account' link on the main menu.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the user account menu.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the documents menu available to users from the 'Docs' link on the main menu.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the documents menu.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the issue list menu available to users from the 'View Issues' link on the main menu.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the issue list menu.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the issue menu available to users when viewing issues.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the issue page menu.

The value can also be an array with a url key and, optionally, new_window set to true to open the link in a new tab, e.g. array( plugin_lang_get( 'mypage_label' ) => array( 'url' => plugin_page( 'mypage' ), 'new_window' => true ) );

For compatibility with MantisBT versions before 2.21.0, it is also possible to return an array of cooked links : array( '' . plugin_lang_get( 'mypage_label' ) . '' ); However, this usage is deprecated.

blockquote.para: This event allows plugins to add new links to the menu under the Relationships section in the View Issue Details page.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of elements to add to the menu.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new menu options to the main menu. New links will be added AFTER the standard menu options.

listitem.para: <Array>: Hooked events may return an array of menu options. Each array entry will contain an associate array with keys 'title', 'url', 'access_level', and 'icon' (e.g. fa-pencil from Font Awesome).

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new menu options to main menu. New links will be added BEFORE the standard menu options.

listitem.para: <Array>: Hooked events may return an array of menu options. Each array entry will contain an associate array with keys 'title', 'url', 'access_level', and 'icon' (e.g. fa-pencil from Font Awesome).

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to modify the complete main menu before it is output (for example re-order items, add items in the middle, remove built-in items, change icons of built-in items).

A single parameter is passed as an array of associate arrays containing the items in the main sidebar menu. The format of this array is the same as EVENT_MENU_MAIN and EVENT_MENU_MAIN_FRONT, and will also contain any entries added as a result of these events.
Plugins should do any modifications needed and return the array back. Returning an empty array will hide the main menu.

note.para: When returning the updated menu, the plugin's hook function needs to wrap it in an array, i.e. return array( $p_menu_data ); and not return $p_menu_data;. The reason for this is that the Event API relies on call_user_func_array() to execute callback functions.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the management menu available to site administrators from the 'Manage' link on the main menu. Plugins should try to minimize use of these links to functions dealing with core MantisBT management.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the management menu.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the configuration management menu available to site administrators from the 'Manage Configuration' link on the standard management menu. Plugins should try to minimize use of these links to functions dealing with core MantisBT configuration.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the manage configuration menu.

blockquote.para: This event gives plugins the opportunity to add new links to the summary menu available to users from the 'Summary' link on the main menu.

listitem.para: <Array>: List of HTML links for the summary menu.

section.title: Page Layout
section.para: These events offer the chance to create output at points relevant to the overall page layout of MantisBT. Page headers, footers, stylesheets, and more can be created. Events listed below are in order of runtime execution.

blockquote.para: This event allows plugins to provide themes. A theme is a list of stylesheets that is linked after all the stylesheets of MantisBT, so it can restyle the pages, and an id that is set as the data-theme attribute of the <html> tag, for use in CSS selectors. The theme in use is set with $g_theme; the default theme, with the id default, has no stylesheets and cannot be replaced.

listitem.para:
<Array>: themes by theme id (letters, digits, hyphens and underscores). Each theme is an array with the keys name, the name to show to users, css, an array of stylesheets to link, in order, as paths relative to the MantisBT directory or full URLs, and optionally color_schemes, an array with light and/or dark if the theme styles them. For such a theme the <html> tag gets a data-color-scheme attribute, light, dark or auto (follow the system, which the theme handles with prefers-color-scheme), from the user's preference, and the page gets a color-scheme meta tag. For example
array( 'ocean' => array( 'name' => plugin_lang_get( 'theme_ocean' ), 'css' => array( plugin_file( 'ocean.css', true ) ), 'color_schemes' => array( 'light', 'dark' ), ) );

A theme can also have viewport_fit, true if it lays the page out under the notches and rounded corners of a phone (the page then gets viewport-fit=cover in its viewport meta tag, and the theme keeps content clear with env( safe-area-inset-* )), and js, an array of scripts, as plugin file URLs or full URLs, that are loaded at the end of the page, after the scripts of MantisBT.

blockquote.para: This event allows plugins to add attributes to the <html> tag of every page, for example data-* attributes that a theme uses in its CSS selectors.

listitem.para: <Array>: attribute values by attribute name, for example array( 'data-theme' => 'dark' ). They are added to the attributes of the tag, replacing any attribute with the same name, except for class, which is added to the classes already there. The values are escaped. A value of true prints the attribute without a value, and false or null leaves it out.

blockquote.para: This event allows plugins to output HTML code from inside the <head> tag, for use with CSS, Javascript, RSS, or any other similar resources. Note that this event is signaled after all other CSS and Javascript resources are linked by MantisBT.
This event allows plugins to add attributes to the <body> tag of every page, including the login pages.

listitem.para: <String>: the kind of page, page for the pages of the application or login for the login, signup and similar pages
<Array>: attribute values by attribute name, handled like those of EVENT_LAYOUT_HTML_ATTRIBUTES.

blockquote.para: This event allows plugins to output HTML code immediately after the <body> tag is opened, so that MantisBT may be integrated within another website's template, or other similar use.
This event allows plugins to output HTML code immediately after the MantisBT header content, such as the logo image.
This event allows plugins to output HTML code after the top main menu, but before any page-specific content begins.
This event allows plugins to output HTML code after any page- specific content has completed, but before the bottom menu bar (or footer).
This event allows plugins to output HTML code after the MantisBT version, copyright, and webmaster information, but before the query information.
This event allows plugins to output HTML code immediately before the </body> end tag, to so that MantisBT may be integrated within another website's template, or other similar use.

This event allows plugins to output HTML code immediately after the line of an attachment. Receives the attachment data as a parameter, in the form of an attachment array from within the array returned by the file_get_visible_attachments() function.

listitem.para: <Array>: the attachment data as an array (see core/file_api.php)
